notes:
PDF has 2 pages. Page 1 holds the header block and Semester One through Semester Seven tables. Page 2 continues with Semester Eight, then Graduation Requirements Summary, Program Notes, University Requirements, and the Codes legend (all excluded per instructions -- only the semester tables were transcribed).

Ambiguities / things a parser could trip on:

1. ENGL 102 (Semester Two) has TWO values stacked in the Code column with no visible separator character: "CC-CMW" on one line and "CC-INF" directly below it in the same cell. Unlike ELCT 403's "MR/CC-INT" (a single slash-joined code that happens to wrap mid-token), there is no slash printed between CC-CMW and CC-INF here. I transcribed this as "CC-CMW CC-INF" (space-joined, following the same-row-wrap-join rule) rather than inventing a slash. A parser could reasonably instead expect "CC-CMW/CC-INF" or two separate code tokens -- flagging this as genuinely ambiguous.

2. EMCH 220's title wraps across two lines as "Mech. Engr. Fund. for Non-" / "Majors". I read this as the hyphenated compound word "Non-Majors" and joined it as "EMCH 220 Mech. Engr. Fund. for Non-Majors", preserving the hyphen. It is possible the underlying word has no hyphen at all (i.e. "NonMajors") and the hyphen is purely an artifact of line-wrap hyphenation, analogous to how "(or ENCP 101)" wraps right after the open paren in the ELCT 101 row. I could not fully disambiguate this from the rendered page alone.

3. Trailing-period inconsistency in Lab course titles was preserved verbatim rather than normalized: "CHEM 111L General Chemistry I Lab" (no period), "PHYS 211L Essentials of Physics I Lab" (no period), but "PHYS 212L Essentials of Physics II Lab." (period) and "ELCT 201 Introductory Elect. Engr. Lab." (period). This looks like a print inconsistency in the source document itself, not a transcription choice.

4. The table has a "Program GPA" column (marked with "*" for courses that count toward the major/program GPA per footnote 2) between Min. Grade and Code. The provided schema has no field for this marker, so it was not captured anywhere in the structured output -- e.g. ELCT 101, CSCE 106, CSCE 212, ELCT 201, ELCT 363, and most Semester 5-8 major/program rows carry a "*" in this column that is simply dropped from this transcription. Flagging in case the parser being tested is expected to reconcile against this column.

2026-2027 disclaimer text, footnote list, "Program Notes" bullets, and the Codes legend table on page 2 were read but intentionally excluded, per the task instructions to include only semester tables.

Footnote digits were kept fused to titles exactly as printed, e.g. "Calculus 13" (MATH 141), "Carolina Core GSS4", "Career Plan Elective5", "Elective6", "Carolina Core VSR4", "Carolina Core CMS4", "Carolina Core GHS4", "Carolina Core AIU4", "Carolina Core GFL7" (this last one appears identically in both Semester Seven and Semester Eight).

total_credits_required ("126") was taken from the "Minimum Total Hours" cell of the Graduation Requirements Summary table on page 2, even though that table itself was excluded from the sections list -- this seemed to be the intended source for that top-level program field.
